drugs.name: Clozapine
drugs.mechanism: Atypical antipsychotic with high affinity for 5-HT2A/5-HT2C and low affinity D2 antagonism
drugs.efficacy: Gold standard for treatment-resistant schizophrenia and reduction of suicidal behavior
drugs.adverse_effects: Agranulocytosis, myocarditis, seizures, severe constipation, sedation

drugs.name: Risperidone
drugs.mechanism: Potent dual dopamine D2 and serotonin 5-HT2A receptor antagonist
drugs.efficacy: Broad efficacy for positive symptoms and acute agitation in schizophrenia
drugs.adverse_effects: Hyperprolactinemia, extrapyramidal symptoms, weight gain, dizziness

drugs.name: Aripiprazole
drugs.mechanism: Dopamine D2 and 5-HT1A receptor partial agonist and 5-HT2A receptor antagonist
drugs.efficacy: Effective antipsychotic with low metabolic and low prolactin elevation risk

drugs.name: Xanomeline-Trospium (KarXT)
drugs.mechanism: Dual M1/M4 muscarinic acetylcholine receptor agonist combined with peripheral muscarinic antagonist
drugs.efficacy: Novel non-D2-blocking mechanism improving positive and negative symptoms without EPS or weight gain

drugs.name: Olanzapine
drugs.mechanism: Thienobenzodiazepine atypical antipsychotic antagonizing D2, 5-HT2A, 5-HT2C, and H1 receptors
drugs.efficacy: High-potency symptom suppression with strong relapse prevention
drugs.adverse_effects: Weight gain, metabolic dysregulation, hyperlipidemia, somnolence
